scope: Four proofs extend the curve polar metric to the full model space of a rank-one background pulled back under a compact holomorphic submersion with connected fibers. Constant Gauduchon fiber volume normalizes the polar trace, giving an exact isometry, analytic closure, ideal retraction and an all-obstacle criterion; every top-degree mass is zero.
next_writing_units: Integrate the four proofs beside the zero-volume product constructions in Chapter16, preserving the submersion and connected-fiber hypotheses. Read the complete changed inputs and seams, rebuild and inspect, refresh the existing catalogue, verify the dated public release and reconstruct the source package. Then investigate singular-fiber extensions and related primary papers without importing their unreviewed assertions.
